# Benchmark results

**Not yet populated.** This file is regenerated by the harness; it is checked in
empty rather than filled with numbers from a machine the code was not run on.

```bash
python bench/bench_attention.py --causal --dtype fp16 --backward
```

The harness overwrites this file with a table of, per shape: median latency and
achieved TFLOP/s for this kernel, for `torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention`,
and for the explicit `softmax(QK^T)V` baseline; peak memory for each; and the
sequence length at which the quadratic baseline runs out of memory.

Numbers are strongly hardware-dependent -- SM count and HBM bandwidth both move
them substantially -- so the harness records GPU name, SM count, VRAM, and the
torch/triton versions alongside every run, in `docs/results.json`.
